premises.text: Social influence among friends is a primary driver of what people buy
premises.evidence_span: You see, friends do help friends discover products

premises.text: Sneak Peek shows friend peeks and real-person product viewing as social proof
premises.evidence_span: you also get to see which of your friends have peeked or looked at that product before

premises.text: Daily curated store from aspirational brand partners personalized by likes

premises.text: Limited peeks drop price competitively until purchase
premises.evidence_span: every peek drops the price for everyone peeking. It drops it intelligently until someone buys

premises.text: One-click purchase after peeking and sizing
premises.evidence_span: it all takes one click to purchase a product

premises.text: Serendipity, friends data, and game mechanics jointly drive discovery and sales
Long-term brand partnerships for impulse sales and social-channel engagement

value.text: Make shopping social again so discovery leads to purchase
